label: World-indexed knowledge and possible…: A Context supplies an actual world, a modal Frame and…
definition: A Context supplies an actual world, a modal Frame and K:(W→Prop)→W→Prop. PossibleKnown c p w means some modally accessible v knows the same predicate p at v; Moore c p w means p holds but Kp fails at that very world. RelevantLaws require factivity and left-conjunct extraction only for this Moore content at worlds accessible from actuality. No actual-only necessitation, agent/time quantification, or relationship between modal and epistemic alternatives is implicit.
note: Analyst formulation for #1053; attribution deferred. Applicability to real knowledge and semantic antirealism remains open. See docs/notes/sep-fitch-knowability-gap-20261106.md.
